title: Batch of log improvements
description:
Use standard buffered I/O instead of printing to a string. This seems to be a lot cleaner.

Add a new "--log-file" option.

notes.body: changed title from **{-wslog: -}Batch of improvements** to **Batch of {+log +}improvements**

added 11 commits
  • be72108b...9aa128c4 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 2d2cfa8d - wslog: Make a variable static
  • e86ac706 - wslog: Parse cmd line options in one pass
  • b91801a8 - wslog: Add a --log-file cmd line option
  • 42c6c478 - wslog: Add a diagnostic message.
  • 59eff637 - wslog: Rename default log level
  • 69a217b9 - wslog: Use buffered I/O
  • 95396973 - wslog: Add basic color support
  • 41fd4631 - wslog: Change log format to display everything
  • dd78347a - capture: Lower priority for some status messages
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3334/diffs?diff_id=200443501&start_sha=be72108b2e937df8ae9537fd3ba36ef5f553b4b2)
